Angry Birds Fight! is a casual Puzzle Quest-style game where players have 45 seconds to match birds of the same color and make them disappear from the game board. The more birds you match, the more attack points you get when the time runs out. Gameplay in Angry Birds Fight! is very simple: move your finger across the screen in order to move the bird.
